final: SELECT c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count, COUNT(o.order_id) - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(o2.order_id) as order_count FROM Orders o2 JOIN Customers c2 ON o2.customer_id = c2.customer_id WHERE o2.date_order_placed >= '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o2.date_order_placed <= '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c2.gender)) as above_average FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed >= '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed <= '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(o2.order_id) as order_count FROM Orders o2 JOIN Customers c2 ON o2.customer_id = c2.customer_id WHERE o2.date_order_placed >= '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o2.date_order_placed <= '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c2.gender))
